title: 第21章 蝎妖目的抽取毒液第22章 心生离意一剑削出的峰
content_zh:
众妖离去了，唯独留下了莫凡。
这让莫凡心中不解的同时也有点慌，不过很快便镇定了。
在他看来既然这黑子妖丁昨日救了自己，那想来是不会害自己的，所以倒也不用太过担心，反倒是他还未曾好好谢过对方搭救之恩。
“正好趁这个机会送几块乳白色石头给这位妖丁老爷，也算是报答他的搭救之恩了，同时也有机会从对方口中得知那石头究竟是何物。”
莫凡心中暗道，接着便听洞府中传来声音：“来宝，进来吧！”
“是，老爷！”
莫凡恭敬的应了一声，接着便朝黑黢黢的洞府中走去。
进入洞府后，莫凡却是眉头微蹙，因为他发现这里几乎连一点光亮都没有，这却是令他心中多少有些慌乱。
“你在找俺吗？”
突然，一道声音在莫凡耳边响起，将他吓了一大跳。
紧接着莫凡便见到一个浑身冒着绿色微光的人影出现在了自己的视线中，正是那黑子妖丁。
“来宝见过老爷！”莫凡见礼道。
“不必客气。”
黑子妖丁一挥手，漆黑的洞府顿时被明亮的灯火照亮，也使得莫凡终于看清了洞内的景象。
在洞内摆放着一张木床以及几张座椅，其中陈设看起来就和人类居所没什么两样，反倒与牛妖大力那些小妖的洞府有着很大的不同。
“你可知俺昨日为何要救你吗？”黑子问道，同时自顾自地坐在椅子上，提起桌子上的酒壶倒了一杯酒水。
“小妖不知，还望老爷能够指点！”莫凡恭敬道。
他的确也很想知道对方究竟是为什么要出手救自己。
昨日若不是这黑子妖丁，他怕是早就死在那独眼妖丁的掌下了，后面也不会那么容易就避开红袍妖将毒牙的算计了。
可无论怎么想，莫凡都不清楚这只蝎妖为何要救自己。

“你是一个很机灵的小妖，俺希望你的聪慧能够为俺所用，如此方能长久的在这黑风山上活下去，而本老爷也刚好缺少一个真正的心腹，俺希望你会是那一个！”
黑子的脸上露出微笑，将手中酒杯递给莫凡，笑道：“这是当初三将军赐给老爷俺的灵酒，据说是在人族地界斩获的，叫什么锻骨酒，你可以尝尝！”
“谢老爷！”
莫凡闻言心中一喜，锻骨酒他可是喝过的，自然知晓其中好处。
当他将杯中酒水送于嘴边，果然闻到了锻骨酒那股独特的香味，同时其中还有一股令他略有些熟悉的气味，只是一时半会儿却是想不起究竟是什么。
莫凡没有多想，在黑子妖丁的注视下将杯中锻骨酒一饮而尽。
“刚刚俺讲到昨日救你之事，其实除了俺与那四将军不对付之外，还有一个十分重要的原因，那便是俺需要你身上的某件东西！”
黑子妖丁突然话音一转，看向莫凡，冲他咧嘴笑了起来。
什么？！
莫凡心头大惊，瞬间就明白这黑子妖丁似乎也没有憋什么好屁，当即便想要逃离这个洞府。
可就在这时，他却是突然发现浑身酥软得厉害，直接就瘫坐在了地上。
这是……醉妖丸！
莫凡终于明白了之前酒水中的那股熟悉的气味是什么了，是醉妖丸的气味！
他曾杀死老猎人，并从其尸体上得到了半瓶子醉妖丸，对那东西的气味自然是了解的，只是刚才一时间却没能联想这么多。
“惨也！”
莫凡心中苦涩，他没想到自己这刚有了转运的契机，便又落得任人鱼肉的下场，当真凄惨。
“不用如此害怕，本老爷并不会要你性命，否则昨日也就不会救你了。”
content_en:
The demons left, leaving only Mo Fan.
This made Mo Fan confused and a little panicked, but he quickly calmed down.
In his opinion, since the black demon Ding saved him yesterday, he probably won't harm him, so he doesn't need to worry too much. On the contrary, he has not thanked him properly for saving him.
"I just took this opportunity to send a few milky-white stones to the demon Ding master. It can be regarded as repaying his kindness of rescuing me. At the same time, I also have the opportunity to learn from the other party what the stones are."
Mo Fan thought to himself, and then heard a voice coming from the cave: "Laibao, come in!"
"Yes, sir!"
Mo Fan responded respectfully, and then walked towards the dark cave.
After entering the cave, Mo Fan frowned slightly because he found that there was almost no light here, which made him somewhat panicked.
"Are you looking for me?"
Suddenly, a voice sounded in Mo Fan's ears, startling him.
Immediately afterwards, Mo Fan saw a figure with a green shimmer appearing in his sight, it was the Heizi Yaoding.
"Laibao has met the master!" Mo Fan said politely.
"You're welcome."
Heizi Yaoding waved his hand, and the dark cave was suddenly illuminated by bright lights, allowing Mo Fan to finally see the scene inside the cave clearly.
There is a wooden bed and several seats placed in the cave. The furnishings look no different from human residences, but are very different from the caves of the little demons like the bull demon Dali.
"Do you know why I saved you yesterday?" Heizi asked, sitting on the chair and picking up the wine bottle on the table and pouring a glass of wine.
"I don't know, little demon, I hope you can give me some advice!" Mo Fan said respectfully.
He really wanted to know why the other party wanted to save him.
If it hadn't been for the black demon ding yesterday, he might have died at the hands of the one-eyed demon ding, and he wouldn't have been able to avoid the poisonous fangs of the red-robed demon general so easily.
But no matter how he thought about it, Mo Fan didn't know why this scorpion demon wanted to save him.
"You are a very clever little demon. I hope that your intelligence can be used to my advantage, so that you can live on this Black Wind Mountain for a long time. And I also happen to lack a true confidant. I hope you will be the one!"
A smile appeared on Heizi's face, and he handed the wine glass in his hand to Mo Fan and said with a smile: "This is the spiritual wine that the three generals gave to me. It is said that it was obtained in the human realm. What is the bone forging wine called? You can try it!"
"Thank you, sir!"
Mo Fan was delighted when he heard this. He had drunk Bone Forging Wine before, so he naturally knew the benefits.
When he put the drink in the glass to his mouth, he smelled the unique aroma of the bone-forging wine, and there was also a slightly familiar smell in it, but he couldn't remember what it was for a while.
Mo Fan didn't think much and drank the bone-forging wine in one gulp under the gaze of Heizi Yaoding.
"I just talked about rescuing you yesterday. In fact, besides me and the four generals not being able to deal with each other, there is another very important reason, that is, I need something from you!"
Black Demon Ding suddenly changed his voice, looked at Mo Fan, and grinned at him.
What? !
Mo Fan was shocked, and instantly understood that this black demon didn't seem to be holding anything back, even if he wanted to escape from this cave.
But at this moment, he suddenly found that his whole body was extremely soft, and he collapsed directly on the ground.
This is... Zui Yao Pill!
Mo Fan finally understood what the familiar smell in the drink was. It was the smell of Zui Yao Pill!
He once killed an old hunter and got half a bottle of Drunken Demon Pills from his corpse. He naturally knew the smell of that thing, but he couldn't think of so much just now.
"It's miserable!"
Mo Fan felt bitter in his heart. He didn't expect that he had just had a chance to change his fortune.It is really miserable to end up as a mermaid again.
"Don't be so afraid. I won't kill you, otherwise I wouldn't have saved you yesterday."
